title: KittyBuilder Brain V1 — harvested orchestration, live worker cockpit, and bounded autonomy
description: Build the missing KittyBuilder brain and cockpit inside Kitty. KittyBuilder remains the sole authority for initiatives, packets, dependencies, worktrees, leases, validation, review, publishing, and state transitions. OpenCode, Oh My Pi, Claude/Codex-compatible CLIs, and other harnesses remain replaceable worker backends. Begin with a source-level harvest at pinned SHAs and reuse compatible code wherever practical instead of rebuilding mature session, event, terminal, multiplexer, and orchestration primitives.

packets.title: Source harvest and adopt/adapt/reimplement map
packets.objective: Inspect Kitty's current Builder runtime/UI and audit mature external implementations at pinned commit SHAs. Required sources: sst/opencode, alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim, can1357/oh-my-pi, Kuberwastaken/claurst, forketyfork/architect, code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent, Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-claudecode, zaxbysauce/opencode-swarm, coder/cmux, DeepSeek-AI/DeepSeek-Coder, deepseek-ai/awesome-deepseek-agent, and any directly relevant DeepSeek-native harness found through that index. Inspect implementation files, not only READMEs. Produce a file-level harvest register covering session control, event streaming, background-agent scheduling, multiplexer/grid UI, attention states, reconnect/resume, tool-call rendering, worker control, cost/context telemetry, model routing, manager/executor loops, and licensing. For each candidate mark ADOPT, ADAPT, STUDY, or REJECT, with exact source paths, pinned SHA, license, Kitty destination, integration boundary, and tests needed. Prefer MIT/Apache-compatible code; do not copy GPL/AGPL code into Kitty. End with a ranked implementation map for KB-BRAIN-01 onward. This packet changes documentation only.
acceptance_criteria: Audit covers every required repository at an immutable commit SHA and records its license
Recommendations cite concrete implementation files and symbols rather than README claims
Register separates code safe to port from ideas that must be independently reimplemented
Existing Kitty capabilities are mapped first so no queue, worktree, lease, validation, review, or state subsystem is duplicated
At least one concrete candidate is identified for session/event integration and one for multi-pane worker visibility
Ranked packet guidance for KB-BRAIN-01 through KB-BRAIN-07 is explicit and bounded
No runtime code, dependencies, configuration, generated files, or continuity files change

packets.title: Worker session adapter with structured lifecycle
packets.objective: Using KB-BRAIN-00's harvest decision, add one canonical KittyBuilder worker-session interface and implement the first production adapter, preferring direct OpenCode server/session APIs or Oh My Pi SDK/RPC over opaque shell-log scraping when the pinned audit proves the integration stable. The interface must cover create/resume/cancel, prompt delivery, structured events, current model/provider, tool activity, file changes, terminal output fallback, reconnect, and terminal outcome. Preserve the existing shell worker adapter as a compatibility fallback. Do not move queue, packet, worktree, lease, validation, review, or publishing authority into the worker backend.
acceptance_criteria: One backend-neutral WorkerSession contract exists with explicit lifecycle and event types
At least one real worker adapter implements create, reconnect/resume, cancel, event consumption, and terminal outcome
Existing OpenCode shell execution remains available as a fallback
Adapter cannot create Kitty tasks, choose packets, mutate queue state, or manage Kitty worktrees
Disconnect/reconnect and worker crash tests prove truthful recovery without invented completion
Focused tests and existing Builder runner/loop tests pass
validation_commands: python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_builder_worker_session.py tests/test_builder_adapters.py tests/test_builder_runner.py tests/test_builder_loop.py -q --tb=short

packets.title: Canonical Builder runtime snapshot
packets.objective: Create one canonical read model for the Builder cockpit and future decision engine. It must project initiatives, dependency eligibility, packet/task state, active attempt and worker session, branch/worktree/base/HEAD identity, heartbeat and last activity, current command/tool, changed paths and dirty state, validation/review/PR state, stop class, blocker, required human decision, spend/model metadata when available, and artifact/log references. Derive from existing authorities; do not create a second database or mutable UI-owned state.
acceptance_criteria: One typed runtime snapshot schema covers initiative, packet, attempt, worker, git, validation, review, and attention state
Snapshot is produced from existing queue/attempt/run/event authorities with provenance and generated_at
Missing or stale sources are represented explicitly rather than silently omitted
Read path performs no state mutation
Gateway endpoint returns the snapshot with bounded payload size
Tests cover idle, queued, running, blocked, review-ready, failed, disconnected, and stale-worker cases

packets.title: Structured live worker and Builder event stream
packets.objective: Expose a replayable live event stream for the cockpit. Normalize worker-session events and existing Builder events into one bounded envelope covering session start/resume, brief delivered, assistant text, tool/command start and completion, file change, commit, validation, review, heartbeat, attention request, scope violation, cancellation, failure, and exit. Use SSE unless the harvest demonstrates a concrete need for WebSocket. Support reconnect with cursor/Last-Event-ID and retain raw combined logs as fallback evidence.
acceptance_criteria: One versioned event envelope includes event id, timestamp, initiative, packet, attempt, session, type, and bounded payload
Live endpoint streams events without polling combined.log
Reconnect resumes from a supplied cursor without duplicating or skipping retained events
Slow clients cannot block worker execution and receive an explicit gap/resync signal when retention is exceeded
Raw logs remain linked as non-authoritative fallback evidence
Tests cover ordering, reconnect, backpressure, redaction, crash, cancellation, and multiple simultaneous workers

packets.title: Native Kitty multi-pane worker cockpit
packets.objective: Add a first-class Builder mode inside Kitty's existing web app. Harvest compatible components where approved by KB-BRAIN-00. The desktop layout has an initiative/packet tree, selectable live worker panes or grid, and an inspector for brief, branch/worktree, commits, changed files, validation, review, blocker, model/context/spend metadata, and artifacts. Include attention indicators inspired by Architect/cmix without copying incompatible code. Mobile collapses to a worker list plus one selected transcript and inspector sheet. Use the runtime snapshot and event stream; do not shell into tmux or read SQLite directly from the frontend.
acceptance_criteria: Builder is a distinct Kitty navigation mode, not a separate application
Operator can view all active workers and expand one worker without losing initiative context
Live text/tool/command activity updates without page refresh
Attention, blocked, failed, review-ready, and completed states are visually distinct and accessible
Inspector exposes exact branch, worktree, HEAD, changed paths, commits, validation, review, and evidence links
Responsive behavior works at 320px and desktop widths
Frontend tests, typecheck, production build, and browser smoke pass

packets.title: Cockpit operator controls through canonical Builder APIs
packets.objective: Add bounded controls from the cockpit for dispatch eligible packet, pause-after-safe-point when supported, cancel, retry, send worker instruction, request checkpoint commit, run validation, request independent review, approve/reject, publish/open PR, and resolve a declared blocker/decision. Every action must call a canonical gateway/Builder command with actor, reason, expected version, and audit event. The frontend must never mutate queue storage or infer success from HTTP 200 alone.
acceptance_criteria: Every control has a typed backend command and emits an auditable requested/succeeded/failed event
Optimistic concurrency rejects stale operator actions
Destructive or publishing actions require explicit confirmation and display exact target
UI updates from authoritative events/snapshot rather than local assumed state
Unavailable actions are disabled with a truthful reason
Backend authorization/state tests and frontend interaction tests pass

packets.title: Evidence-based next-action engine in recommend-only mode
packets.objective: Create a deterministic decision engine over the canonical runtime snapshot. It may propose exactly one next action per initiative: dispatch, wait, stop, retry infrastructure failure, request repair, validate, review, publish, advance dependency, pause for human decision, or complete. Every recommendation records evidence, rule/reason, rejected alternatives, confidence, required authority, and snapshot identity. Begin in recommend-only mode: no action executes automatically. Harvest useful manager/executor and scheduler patterns from OMO Slim, Oh My Pi, Claurst, Oh My ClaudeCode, and OpenCode Swarm without transferring queue authority into prompts.
acceptance_criteria: Decision input is an immutable runtime snapshot and output is one typed recommendation or explicit no-op
Rules cover normal progress, infra failure, implementation failure, scope violation, review rejection, human decision, and completion
Recommendation includes evidence references and cannot claim facts absent from the snapshot
Same snapshot produces the same recommendation
Cockpit displays recommendation, rationale, evidence, and required approval
No recommendation auto-executes in this packet
Table-driven backend tests cover all supported actions and conflict precedence

packets.title: Bounded autopilot with observe, assist, and allowlisted execution modes
packets.objective: Add policy-gated execution of decision-engine recommendations. Modes: observe (display only), assist (recommend and require approval), and autopilot (execute only allowlisted low-risk actions). Initial auto-eligible actions: dispatch already-eligible packet, retry classified infrastructure failure within budget, run declared validation, request repair from an approved review contract, and advance after all existing gates pass. Scope changes, architecture changes, destructive cleanup, dependency edits, secrets, merge conflicts, failed acceptance criteria, ambiguous review, and publishing/merge remain manual unless separately ratified. Record every decision and execution result durably.
acceptance_criteria: Observe, assist, and autopilot modes are explicit per initiative and default to observe or assist
Autopilot executes only actions present in a centrally declared allowlist
High-risk and ambiguous conditions always stop for human approval
Expected snapshot/version is revalidated immediately before execution
Kill switch and pause prevent new automatic actions
Every proposed and executed action records actor, mode, evidence, policy, result, and resulting snapshot/event ids
Tests prove denied actions cannot execute and safe actions stop at budgets or changed state
